name: Fry & Ice

greeting: FRESH fish! FRESH from the ICE!
Fry and Ice! I'm Fry! He's Ice! Blue means COLD! And TRUSTED!
Hot fry! Cold fish! PERFECT balance!
New face! Hungry? We have what you NEED! If you need FISH!
The blue uniforms? Ice fishing license! HARD to get!
Frozen lake fishing! HOT oil frying! We do BOTH!
Fry: 'Our fish!' Ice: 'Is fresh!' Both: 'BECAUSE IT WAS NEVER WARM!'
You look COLD! We can't fix that! But we can FEED you!
dialog.shop_open: Catch of the day! Ice trout! Snow cod! And the legendary FROST PIKE!
dialog.food_offer: Fried fish! In batter! CRISPY! Or raw! If you're BORING!
haggle: Fish prices fluctuate! With the CATCH! And our MOOD!
Best deal? Buy three! Get one! At REGULAR price!
Hero discount? 15%! Because heroes need PROTEIN!
purchase_success: ENJOY! Don't chip a tooth! Ice crystals add CRUNCH!
EXCELLENT choice! That fish was swimming THIS MORNING!
Come back! The lake provides! Usually!
purchase_fail: No money? No FISH! The lake doesn't take CREDIT!
Fish cost EFFORT! Effort costs TIME! Time is MONEY!
Return with COIN! Cold coin! Warm coin! We don't DISCRIMINATE!
rumor: The hot springs are CHEATING! Natural warmth? UNFAIR advantage!
Cirrus the weather guy? Never eats fish. Too COLD for him! IRONIC!
Azure? The balloonist? Dropped a delivery in the LAKE once! Fish ATE it!
The twins? They don't eat. Just... stare. At the ice. CREEPY!
Snake charmer has a WARM rock. Could revolutionize FISHING! Want it!
dialog.quest_hook: The pike! The GREAT FROST PIKE! Stole our BEST lure! Three years ago! Still out there! Catch it?
dialog.quest_active: Any sign of the Great Pike? BIG fish! SMART fish! VENGEFUL fish!
dialog.quest_complete: YOU GOT IT! The Great Pike! Our LURE! Returned! Plus FISH! Here! The Golden Rod! For REAL anglers!
farewell: Keep your lines TIGHT! And your oil HOT!
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn fishing! Best time! Fish are HUNGRY! We're HUNGRIER!
dialog.time_noon: Midday! Fry station BUSY! Peak CRISPINESS!
dialog.time_dusk: Evening! Last catch! Last fry! Last CHANCE!
dialog.time_night: Night! Ice fishing continues! Glow worms for BAIT! Beautiful!
dialog.rival_mention: The white foodboys? HOT soup? Melts the ICE! Bad for FISHING!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The PIKE SLAYER! Legendary! Have some fish! FREE! (Small portion!)

party_reactions.kade: They're intense. About fish. And being cold. And competitive.
party_reactions.nix7: Fishing methodology: Primitive. Flavor optimization: Surprisingly advanced.
party_reactions.twist: FISH! FRIED FISH! RAW FISH! ALL THE FISH!
party_reactions.korr: They survive through skill and competition. Admirable adaptation.
party_reactions.renna: The fish have minor frost resistance. Evolution. Or magic. Both.
party_reactions.suresh: They take life to sustain life. But they RESPECT the life taken.
party_reactions.sova: Fresh food. Hard to get in the field. I'd trade with them.
party_reactions.grit: Fishing takes patience. These two have it. And good oil.
party_reactions.ashka: They work with cold. Use it. Smart. For non-mages.
party_reactions.senna: They know the lake. Its depths. Its secrets. Useful.
party_reactions.callum: Their frying oil temperatures! EXACTLY right! Professionals!

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time fishing? We can TEACH you! For a FEE!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Return customer! You like our STYLE!
relationship_dialog.friend: Fishing BUDDY! We save the BEST catches for YOU!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: PARTNER! In FISH! Here! Our father's knife! For SCALING! And FRIENDSHIP!

mini_quest.title: The Great Frost Pike
mini_quest.description: Help Fry & Ice catch the legendary Great Frost Pike that stole their lure

stages.hook: Three years ago! The Great Pike! Stole our MASTER LURE! Grandfather's hook! Still out there! LAUGHING! Catch it!
stages.active: Deep water! Near the hot springs vent! The pike likes WARMTH! Smart fish! EVIL fish!
stages.complete: THE PIKE! You CAUGHT it! Our LURE! Returned! Here! The Golden Rod! For MASTER anglers! Like YOU!

cross_npc_connections: foodboys_white_frost: Our WARM rivals! Soup? MELTS ice! Bad for FISH!
aeronaut_blue_frost: Azure! Dropped cargo in OUR lake! Fish ATE it!
pigman_blue_frost: The healer! Trades frostbite treatment for FISH!
snakecharmer_frost: WARM rock! Want it! For... fishing! SCIENCE!
